create_worker: create a new Worker entry in the Mephisto database using Worker.new with a worker name
get_worker_agents: get the list of agents for a Worker filtered by optional agent status
grant_worker_qualification: grant a qualification to a Worker with a value and optional crowd provider sync
revoke_worker_qualification: revoke a qualification from a Worker locally and optionally from the crowd provider
check_worker_qualified: check if a Worker is qualified or disqualified by name using is_qualified or is_disqualified
